description: An additive oscillator built from sixteen sine waves: four harmonics, each with a minor third, a major third and a fifth above it

params.text: Sets the pitch in whole octaves, three either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level of that sine, from silence to full

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, an octave per volt, added to the OCTAVE knob and held within four octaves either side of C4
Adds to that sine's level, a fifth per volt

outputs.text: All sixteen sines added together and scaled so that the total comes out at about ±5V whatever the knobs are set to

notes: the first column is the harmonic itself and the other three are a minor third, a major third and a fifth above it, at frequency ratios of 1.2, 1.25 and 1.5.
the four rows are the first, second, third and fourth harmonic, so the whole grid spans two octaves and a fifth above the note played.
the mix is divided by the sum of all sixteen levels, so turning one sine up quietens the rest rather than making the whole louder; with every knob at zero the output is silent.
the sines are free running and never reset, so the same note played twice does not give the same waveform.
